blocks.p: When the game starts, it opens on a desk with a monitor on it. The monitor holds the main menu: the menu bar along its top, a column of icons down its right side, and the windows that the menu opens. Each screen of the main menu opens in a window on the monitor.
The menu bar holds the *ZeD*, *File*, *Multiplayer* and *Settings* menus, with the time at its right end. The *Settings* menu is described in Chapter 46.
The icons open the same screens as the menu. From the top, they are *Project Zomboid*, *New game*, *Load game*, *Join a server*, *Options*, *Mods* and *Mod Uploader*.
*Trash*, at the foot of the column, opens the *Trash* window. The window lists what is in the trash, each item with its size, and has *Close* and *Empty trash* in the band at its foot.

blocks.note: *Options* is described in Chapter 48 and *Mods* in Chapter 50.
